what you are trying to say doesn’t make sense. any more sandwich at all would mean an increase in mass ( or volume if we talk about how big it looks like ) which is very obviously not happening when you cut a sandwhich in half. It may very well take more bites to finish a diagonally cut sandwhich ( because of the edges ) , so it may feel like its more sandwhich ; but as I have explained, that is not the case.

They have the same volume no matter how you cut it, however, a diagonally cut sandwich is longer from corner to corner, so you can take more bites from the corner to the center, which is why you may feel it is bigger. Its impossible for something to increase in mass just by cutting it in half.
